breaking_news.headline: The U.S. adds 172,000 jobs. Many are in restaurants, bars and hotels
breaking_news.summary: U.S. employers added jobs for the third month in a row in May, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.3%. But wage gains softened and likely failed to keep pace with rising prices.

breaking_news.headline: In the wake of layoffs, some tech workers are exploring new careers
breaking_news.summary: Amid widespread tech layoffs, some highly skilled workers are making radical career changes. Some laid-off workers are turning to lower paying temp jobs, and some are leaving tech altogether.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi and Polymarket crack down on paid influencers claiming election fraud
breaking_news.summary: Influencers are using prediction market odds to sow doubt in vote counting, in some cases in posts paid for by the companies themselves.

breaking_news.headline: Former '60 Minutes' correspondent Scott Pelley speaks out after firing
breaking_news.summary: Former 60 Minutes correspondent Scott Pelley said CBS news leader Bari Weiss shouldn't be leading the network. Pelley spoke to The New York Times just days after being fired by CBS.

breaking_news.headline: NPR's new chief content officer: 'I've been training for this job my whole life'
breaking_news.summary: Less than two weeks after overhauling its newsroom, NPR has hired Nadine Zylstra to be its chief content officer. She has been a top executive at Sesame Workshop, YouTube and Pinterest.

breaking_news.headline: With just days left, the U.S. opening match at the World Cup is still not sold out
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of tickets are still available for the U.S. and Canada opening matches for the World Cup on Friday. Even more are available in resale platforms — many at below face value.

breaking_news.headline: Hey, Siri: Apple just announced a long-awaited AI update
breaking_news.summary: At its annual developers' conference, Apple put the spotlight on new AI features, while highlighting security and child safety — and critiquing the company's AI competitors.

breaking_news.headline: Social Security funds could run short by 2032, program's Trustees warn
breaking_news.summary: A trust fund that helps to finance Social Security benefits is expected to run out of money in less than seven years — unless Congress acts to patch the system before that.

breaking_news.headline: Man reportedly shot at Kenya protest against US Ebola quarantine centre
breaking_news.summary: Protesters are concerned about cross-border infection risks and the lack of transparency from the government about the treatment centre.

breaking_news.headline: I have right papers and visa - barred referee Artan
breaking_news.summary: Somali referee Omar Artan says he was subjected to an 11-hour immigration interview before being denied entry to the United States for the World Cup despite holding the "right papers" and "right visa".

breaking_news.headline: UK and allies sanction 'networks' enabling settler violence in West Bank
breaking_news.summary: France will also bar far-right Israeli Minister Bezalel Smotrich from entry as part of the measures, which Israel condemns as "disgraceful".

breaking_news.headline: Murder of Lyhanna, 11, enrages France and turns up heat on government
breaking_news.summary: Protesters are angry that the suspect had already been reported to police last August in a separate case.

breaking_news.headline: Nasa names next astronauts for Artemis Moon programme
breaking_news.summary: Nasa names its next Artemis crew, though they will not be walking on the Moon or even going anywhere near it.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli air strikes hit Lebanese city of Tyre despite Iranian warning to stop attacks
breaking_news.summary: Iran warned Israel on Monday that it could resume hostilities if attacks on its Lebanese ally Hezbollah do not stop.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says Iran shot down US helicopter and vows to respond
breaking_news.summary: Two crew members of the Apache helicopter that crashed following the attack were rescued by an American sea drone.

breaking_news.headline: Inside Myanmar, rebels are losing ground as military forces men into army
breaking_news.summary: The BBC travels with rebels to frontline positions in Myanmar to see how the war is unfolding.

breaking_news.headline: Final piece of 'iconic' Denby Pottery signed
breaking_news.summary: The firm, founded in 1809, appointed administrators due to rising energy and labour costs.

breaking_news.headline: How driving test booking is changing for learner drivers
breaking_news.summary: From 12 May, only learner drivers can book their own tests, not instructors.

breaking_news.headline: Could humanoid robots be heading for the battlefield?
breaking_news.summary: Armed forces are experimenting with humanoid robots, but battlefield deployment is some way off.

breaking_news.headline: US adds BYD to list of firms with alleged Chinese military ties
breaking_news.summary: The Pentagon list warns US firms of risks linked to working with flagged Chinese companies.
